checks.name: route_and_auth_contract
checks.evidence: GET /api/v2/products is registered in ProductController and has no Authorize requirement. Supported query fields are pageIndex, pageSize, search, priceFrom, priceTo, sortBy, categoryIds, and isPin.

checks.name: api_build
checks.evidence: dotnet build HoaTheoMua.API/HoaTheoMua.API.csproj --no-restore --disable-build-servers completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

checks.name: v2_service_contract_tests
checks.evidence: 16/16 tests selected by FullyQualifiedName~LocalProductSearchV2Test|FullyQualifiedName~UT_004 passed. Coverage includes position sorting, isPin filtering, search normalization, category mapping, pagination data, combo quantity, stock status, and unavailable reasons.

checks.name: http_startup_and_probe
checks.evidence: The API reads its local configuration successfully but exits in Program.cs during Database.MigrateAsync because PostgreSQL at 127.0.0.1:5433 refuses the connection. No HTTP listener becomes available.

checks.name: pagination_response_metadata
checks.evidence: ApiResponseFactory.BasePagination does not populate TraceId or TimestampUtc. ProductController returns this object directly, so V2 cannot provide a useful correlation ID and emits the default DateTime value.

checks.name: pagination_input_safety
checks.evidence: GetLocalProductsV2 computes Skip with int arithmetic: (pageIndex - 1) * pageSize. Very large positive pageIndex values can overflow to a negative offset. ApiResponseFactory also multiplies pageIndex * pageSize with int arithmetic for HasNextPage.

checks.name: deterministic_page_order
checks.evidence: The final ordering uses Position and optional CreatedAt/price/name but has no unique Id tiebreaker. Rows tied on all selected fields can move between pages across executions.

failures: HTTP verification is blocked until a PostgreSQL instance is available at 127.0.0.1:5433 with the configured database and credentials.
Pagination responses omit correlation and timestamp metadata.
Pagination arithmetic can overflow for extreme pageIndex values.
Pagination ordering is not deterministic when sort fields tie.
redactions: JWT signing key and external API tokens were not recorded.
